title: Drifter Desserts Apple Pie 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Apple Pie by Drifter Desserts recreates the taste of a classic bakery favourite, combining warm spiced Apple with a buttery pastry base. Sweet, crisp fruit notes meet gentle spice and rich pastry layers, offering a familiar and satisfying dessert vape. This Nic Salt e-liquid is mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, delivering discreet vapour, clear flavour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it’s best used with pod kits, refillable vape pens, and starter devices. With nicotine options of 5mg, 10mg and 20mg, it provides flexibility for different preferences. Crafted in the UK by Juice Sauz, the Drifter Desserts collection showcases dessert-inspired blends designed to bring classic sweet flavours to your vape kit. Crafted for refillable vapes and starter vape kit users seeking simple, satisfying vaping.
